title: Annihilation Power
description: Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.

puzzle.goal: A particle and its antiparticle, each of rest mass m, meet with momenta p⃗1 and p⃗2 and annihilate completely into radiation. A reactor converts a fraction η of the radiation into useful energy. Write the useful energy as the sum of the two particles' total relativistic energies.
puzzle.name: Annihilation energy from the energy–momentum relation
puzzle.ask: In a trap both particles are essentially at rest. Find the useful energy in MJ when 1 μg (1e-9 kg) of antimatter annihilates with 1 μg of matter at efficiency η = @{η}.

vars.p: momentum (p₁ of the particle, p₂ of the antiparticle)

puzzle.method: Each particle's total energy follows from E² = p²c² + m²c⁴; all of it is converted to photons, so add both energies and apply the efficiency.
